tooltips.barcode: A unique code to identify this product (e.g. EAN13).

tooltips.code: The unique code users will enter (e.g. SUMMER2024). Uppercase only.
tooltips.type: The logic used to calculate the discount.
tooltips.value: The numerical value of the discount.
tooltips.maxDiscount: The maximum amount that can be deducted.
tooltips.minOrder: Minimum subtotal required to use this code.
tooltips.usageLimit: Total number of times this code can be used by anyone.
tooltips.usagePerUser: How many times a single user can use this code.
tooltips.userSegment: Select which group of users can use this code.
tooltips.productScope: Define if this applies to the whole order or specific items.

tooltips.promoMessageAr: Message shown to the user when code is applied (Arabic).

bogo.getFrom: Product source for the 'get' item (same product, specific, or category).
bogo.discountType: Type of discount for the 'get' item (Free, %, Fixed).
bogo.maxPerOrder: Maximum times this rule can apply per order.
bogo.getProductId: Barcode of the product to give.
bogo.getCategoryId: Category of products to give from.
